title: Run the SpecSync archive gate before every CI job
description: Run the SpecSync archive gate before every CI job
no_spec_change_rationale: CI workflow ordering only; no canonical spec owns .github/workflows
acceptance_criteria: Every workflow that runs on pull_request or push (docs, macOS, trust, ubuntu) starts with a job named Archive (id archive-gate) that runs CorvidLabs/spec-sync pinned to 106aaa43d0bcf049f19b173ddb63815a25c3f931 with archive-gate-only, and every other job needs it directly or transitively, so no other CI job runs while any SpecSync change under .specsync/changes/ is still open.
